name: Enamoring Exhalation
descr:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

Your riding dragonet enraptures those nearby, exhaling a 15-foot [cone](/rule/cone-rules-2386) of pheromones that fascinates those within it. Each creature in the area is [fascinated](/condition/fascinated-player-core) with you and your dragonet until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. This uses a trained DC using the dragonet’s Charisma modifier, or an expert DC if the dragonet is [specialized](/rule/specialized-animal-companions-rules-2120).
